data.name: Neelam
data.gender_notes: Neelam is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious stone, often used to adorn jewelry, representing beauty, wealth, and status. The name Neelam carries the meaning “Jewel, Gem, Pearl” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Hindi, Arabic. Parents who choose Neelam usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, gem, pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner beauty, purity, and grace, reflecting the divine light within.
data.etymology: Neelam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Gem, Pearl.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neelam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نيلم
in_arabic.meaning: نيلم تعني اللون الأزرق أو الحجر الأزرق
in_arabic.long_meaning: نيلم هو اسم مشتق من اللغة العربية، ويعني اللون الأزرق أو الحجر الأزرق. ويرتبط هذا اللون بالسماء والبحر، ويعتبر من الألوان الجميلة والمميزة. وقد ورد ذكر الحجر الأزرق في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر، حيث قال تعالى: «وَالحِجْرِ وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الحِجْرُ» (الحجر: 76). وقد استخدم هذا الحجر في الحلي والمجوهرات في العصور القديمة، ويعتبر من الرموز الجمالية والثقافية في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نیلم
in_urdu.meaning: نیلم مرادف ہے نیلا رنگ یا نیلا پتھر
in_urdu.long_meaning: نیلم ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نیلا رنگ یا نیلا پتھر۔ یہ رنگ آسمان اور سمندر کی یاد دلاتا ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں جمالیاتی اور روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ عربی زبان میں، نیلم (nīlam) 'نيل' (nīl) سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'نیلا'۔ یہ نام اکثر خوبصورتی، سکون اور روحانی گہرائی کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، نیلم ایک مقبول نام ہے جو خوبصورتی اور جمالیات کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नीलम
in_hindi.meaning: नीलम का अर्थ है नीला रंग या नीला पत्थर
in_hindi.long_meaning: नीलम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है नीला रंग या नीला पत्थर। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसका उपयोग अक्सर सौंदर्य, शांति और आध्यात्मिक गहराई के प्रतीक के रूप में किया जाता है। नीलम नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जहां 'नील' (nīl) का अर्थ है 'नीला'। इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में सौंदर्य और आध्यात्मिकता की 상징 के रूप में किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نیلم
in_pashto.meaning: نیلم معنی یې نیلا رنګ یا نیلا ډبره
in_pashto.long_meaning: نیلم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې معنی یې نیلا رنګ یا نیلا ډبره ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې ډیر مشهور دی او اکثرا د ښکلا، آرامۍ او روحانيت د نښه په توګه کارول کېږي. په پښتو ژبه کې، نیلم د نیلا رنګ او د هغې د روحاني او ثقافتي اهمیت سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Neelam
in_english.meaning: Neelam means blue color or blue gemstone
in_english.long_meaning: Neelam is an Arabic name derived from the word 'nīl', meaning 'blue'. It symbolizes the color blue, often associated with the sky and sea. In Islamic tradition, Neelam is used to signify beauty, serenity, and spiritual depth. The name has historical significance in various Muslim cultures, representing aesthetic and cultural values. Neelam is popular in South Asian and Middle Eastern communities, reflecting its roots in Arabic linguistic and cultural heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Neelam, like the precious blue sapphire gemstone it represents, is deeply rooted in Islamic culture. In many Islamic countries, sapphires have long been considered a symbol of wealth, power, and beauty. Neelam can therefore evoke images of high status and prestige. In poetry and literature, the name is used to describe a beloved's eyes, imbuing them with the depth and allure of the precious stone.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic traditions, the color blue is often associated with spiritual purity and divine wisdom. The sapphire, with its deep blue hue, is believed to possess supernatural qualities, such as the ability to protect and heal. By naming a child Neelam, parents may be expressing their hope that their child will possess these virtues – the purity and wisdom of a sapphire. The name may also serve as a reminder of the beauty and divine nature of the world around us, inspiring the child to seek knowledge and wisdom in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Jewel, Gem, Pearl" symbolizes A precious stone, often used to adorn jewelry, representing beauty, wealth, and status.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Neelam serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of jewel, gem, pearl.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that In Persian mythology, Neelam is a name of the goddess of the sea. The name Neelam carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Neelam was associated with the goddess of the sea and was often depicted as a beautiful and powerful figure.
